categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches src/wallet/export.cpp and src/wallet/walletutil.h to add a require_sane parameter so wallets with previously valid descriptors continue to load rather than failing with error -4.
categories.rationale: Fixes a BIP-379 violation where Tapscript Miniscript duplicate-key checks allowed keys differing only in parity, enabling third-party transaction malleation, while ensuring existing wallets containing such descriptors remain loadable.
